name: LLM Council
description: Karpathy-style LLM Council: Opus, Sonnet and Gemini Flash answer in parallel, anonymously peer-review and rank each other, and an Opus chairman synthesizes the final answer.
author: local
safetyNotes: Declarative skill only. agent.prompt.inject is used solely to index the LLM Council skill for the agent's Skill tool. main.js does nothing at runtime. The bundled scripts/council.py is run by the agent itself (via its normal shell tool) to anonymize answers, parse rankings and write a report inside the workspace run directory; it makes no network calls.
